item.title: Rainfall Advisory No. 14 #NCRPRSD
item.description:
Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 14 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Southwest Monsoon (Habagat)
Issued at: 11:00 AM, 18 August 2026(Tuesday)

RED WARNING LEVEL: Bataan, Batangas(Agoncillo, Alitagtag, Balayan, Balete, Batangas City, Bauan, Calaca, Calatagan, Cuenca, Ibaan, Laurel, Lemery, Lian, Lobo, Mabini, Mataasnakahoy, Nasugbu, San Jose, San Luis, San Nicolas, San Pascual, Santa Teresita, Taal, Taysan, Tingloy, Tuy, Lipa, Padre Garcia, Rosario, San Juan, Malvar, Talisay), Zambales(Olongapo, Subic, Castillejos, San Antonio) and Quezon(Tiaong, San Antonio).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: Serious FLOODING is expected in flood-prone areas.

ORANGE WARNING LEVEL: Cavite(Alfonso, Amadeo, General Trias, General Emilio Aguinaldo, Indang, Magallanes, Maragondon, Mendez, Silang, Tagaytay, Ternate, Trece Martires, Naic, Noveleta, Rosario, Tanza, Cavite City, Carmona, Gen. Mariano Alvarez, Dasmarinas, Imus, Kawit), Laguna(Calauan, Bay, Cabuyao, Calamba, Santa Rosa, Los Banos, Nagcarlan, Victoria, Rizal, Binan, Alaminos, San Pablo), Zambales(Cabangan, Botolan, Iba, Palauig, San Marcelino, San Felipe, San Narciso), Pampanga(Porac, Guagua, Santa Rita, Minalin, Masantol, Macabebe, Sasmuan, Bacolor, Floridablanca, Lubao), Bulacan(Hagonoy, Paombong), Quezon(Dolores, Candelaria, Sariaya) and Batangas(Tanauan, Santo Tomas).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING is THREATENING.

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Metro Manila, Zambales(Candelaria, Masinloc, Santa Cruz), Cavite(Bacoor), Laguna(San Pedro, Cavinti, Liliw, Luisiana, Magdalena, Majayjay, Pagsanjan, Pila, Santa Cruz), Rizal(Rodriguez, San Mateo, Antipolo, Cainta, Taytay, Angono, Binangonan, Morong, Teresa, Cardona), Pampanga(Apalit, Arayat, Candaba, San Fernando, Magalang, Mexico, San Luis, San Simon, Santa Ana, Santo Tomas, Angeles, Mabalacat), Tarlac(Bamban, Capas, Mayantoc, San Jose), Bulacan(Balagtas, Baliuag, Bocaue, Bulakan, Bustos, Calumpit, Malolos, Meycauayan, Guiguinto, Marilao, Obando, Pandi, Plaridel, Pulilan, Santa Maria) and Quezon(Lucban, Tayabas, Lucena).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING in flood-prone areas.


Meanwhile, light to moderate with occasional heavy rains affecting Nueva Ecija, Rizal(Tanay, Baras, Jala-Jala, Pililla), Quezon(General Nakar, Infanta, Mauban, Real, Sampaloc, Agdangan, Alabat, Atimonan, Buenavista, Burdeos, Calauag, Catanauan, General Luna, Guinayangan, Gumaca, Jomalig, Lopez, Macalelon, Mulanay, Padre Burgos, Panukulan, Patnanungan, Perez, Pitogo, Plaridel, Polillo, Quezon, San Andres, San Francisco, San Narciso, Tagkawayan, Unisan, Pagbilao), Laguna(Famy, Kalayaan, Lumban, Mabitac, Paete, Pakil, Pangil, Santa Maria, Siniloan), Tarlac(Concepcion, Anao, Tarlac City, Gerona, La Paz, Paniqui, Pura, Ramos, San Manuel, Victoria, Camiling, Moncada, San Clemente, Santa Ignacia) and Bulacan(Angat, San Jose del Monte, Dona Remedios Trinidad, Norzagaray, San Ildefonso, San Miguel, San Rafael) which may persist within 3 hours.
The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 2:00 PM today.
For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to www.pagasa.dost.gov.ph.
